title: Mesh tools in core: decimate, remesh, unwrap

questions.q: In which order should you run these nodes on a generated mesh?
questions.why: The nodes' descriptions say to remesh before decimating, and to unwrap after both. Later steps would destroy the UVs.

questions.q: Why does UnwrapMesh return more vertices than it was given?
options: Vertices on chart seams are duplicated, one per chart, with the same position and different UVs
It keeps the old mesh too
questions.answer: Vertices on chart seams are duplicated, one per chart, with the same position and different UVs
questions.why: Its description says so. Our sphere went from 2562 to 2960 on the same 5120 faces.

questions.q: What does RemeshMesh's resolution do to its memory floor?
options: It grows with the cube: doubling it costs 8 times as much
It grows in line with resolution
It grows with the face count only
questions.answer: It grows with the cube: doubling it costs 8 times as much
questions.why: memory_required takes resolution cubed x 64 bytes against faces x 512, whichever is larger.

questions.q: You get thousands of one-triangle charts from UnwrapMesh. What's the likely cause?
options: The input isn't welded, so raise weld_distance
questions.answer: The input isn't welded, so raise weld_distance
questions.why: The tooltip says to raise it to about 0.001 for per-triangle charts on unwelded input. Basic voxel meshes are unwelded.

questions.q: Which triangles does QEM decimation remove first?
options: Those where a collapse changes the shape least, such as flat areas
questions.answer: Those where a collapse changes the shape least, such as flat areas
questions.why: An edge's cost measures how far the merged vertex sits from the original planes, and low-cost edges go first.

questions.q: What's the difference between udf and sdf in RemeshMesh's sign_mode?
options: udf is robust to messy input and sdf gives a clean surface but needs consistent winding
udf is for images and sdf for video
udf is on a CPU and sdf on a GPU
questions.answer: udf is robust to messy input and sdf gives a clean surface but needs consistent winding
questions.why: The sign_mode tooltip says so, and adds that solid makes one watertight solid by a graph cut.
